brief: Holds the security invariants that see paths in a security graph, so an escalation by any route is caught, not only a direct grant.
detail: Three rules are loaded. sandboxed-reaches-effectful finds a sandboxed actor that can reach the effectful capability by any path, though it holds none itself. sandboxed-holds-secret finds a sandboxed actor attached to a live secret. unstored-secret finds a secret that a site references but that lives in no store, so its reveals are unaudited. Each rule governs only the nodes it is about, so a clean report can tell no sandboxed actor can reach an effect from there is no sandboxed actor.
